tasks.name: Recent Files + Workspace Persistence
tasks.modelRationale: Unassigned. Select an approved available model for actual execution; no historical model is known.
deliverables: Validate SQLite migration and fallback behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Validate SQLite migration and fallback behavior

executionResult.executionNotes: Added recent PDF history with pin, unpin, remove, desktop path-based reopen, and bounded unpinned history. Persisted and restored per-document page and zoom through the existing LocalStorage/IndexedDB settings backends; protected documents are opened without persisting PDF bytes. P1-S3-005 subsequently added per-document theme and viewing-mode restoration. The user selected keeping the existing backends rather than adding SQLite; SQLite is not implemented in this repository (desktop currently uses LocalStorage).

deliverables: Modern light editor workspace with consistent toolbar, controls, sidebar, page stage, and panel styling
Responsive desktop and narrow extension-window layout without page-level horizontal overflow

acceptanceCriteria: At desktop width, product/document controls, search, action rail, viewer controls, navigation sidebar, and page canvas have clear visual hierarchy and consistent modern styling

userClarifications: User chose a modern light visual direction and scoped the change to the main editor workspace as a Phase 1 MVP acceptance fix.

executionResult.executionNotes: Implemented the modern light workspace, responsive toolbar/sidebar/page-stage layout, and scoped desktop/extension style budgets. The exact model identifier was not exposed by runtime metadata. Validated the rendered two-page demo PDF, thumbnail/sidebar layout, dark/light theme switch, and no page-level horizontal overflow at 1366px and 390px.

verification.summary: All 53 focused workspace tests passed in Microsoft Edge 155. Desktop production and Chrome extension builds passed. A browser preview rendered the bundled two-page PDF with canvas and thumbnails; 1366px and 390px layouts had no document-level horizontal overflow, and dark/light theme switching worked.
